pins.held_context: Actual descriptor/provider owner: operation64=producer, phase32=transport, generation32=irs_serial. Physical rank7/stack2 from actualDS routing frame. Require realowner-valid; if absent refuse row/descriptor admission. No zero/default/local generation.
pins.posted_ingress: wr_v/wr_r,bank[4:0],row[18:0],col[4:0],data[255:0],generation[31:0] latched actualprovider irs_serial, actualwriter to adapter; retained lease before controller WQpush
pins.controller_queue: wq_v/wq_r,bank5,row19,col5,data256; wq_v only reserved ingress handshake. No fake writer ready.
pins.controller_issue: col_v,col_we,col_bank5,col_row19,col_col5,col_data256; nonbackpressured. Validate oldest retained WRITE on WRissue.
pins.PHY_output: phy_col_v/phy_col_r,phy_we,bank5,row19,col5,data256 plus full issued receipt tuple forWRITE. FIFOenqueue on actualcol_v; pop only actualPHYaccept. Store write_slot3 WITH the PHY FIFO command at WRissue; do not reconstruct slot from address on return.
pins.PHY_visibility: visible_v/visible_r + operation64/phase32/sector34/generation32/slot3/pc5/bank5/row19/col5; accept only full match live+issued+actualPHYaccepted, once
pins.writer_receipt: wr_visible_v/wr_visible_r + same tuple; free lease only writerreceipt accepted, not WRissue/PHYqueuepop

Rawls_module.physical_sector_definition: sector34={row19,bank[4:2],col5,bank[1:0],pc5}; exact PC-localDS stream physical address. NOT canonical provider pc_of/hash or logical source aperture.
Rawls_module.read_reservation: 64 outstanding credits borrowed from actual readlanding64; no post-pop PHY gating. Parent returns actual CDC rd_freed only. Queue72 covers maximum64RD+8WR.
Rawls_module.write_reservation: 8 includes controllerqueued+PHYqueued+PHYinflight+visible-notreturned. No second8 WRissue credit pool.
Rawls_module.cold_generation: generation caller-supplied; operation/phase held. All pending retained until positive realmatchedreceipt. No warmreset/clear.
Rawls_module.out_of_order_visibility: fullreceipt matching; FIFO WRissue binding remains originalWQ order; perwrite completed state retained until writeracceptance
Rawls_module.owner: Euclid; inseparable queued/issue binding in parent. Rawls only source-list helper as agreed.
